title: Lead beyond the feed: Claim your spot in the Galaxy Campus Batch 4
summary: The search is on for the new batch of Galaxy trailblazers as Samsung opens the applications for the Galaxy Campus Batch 4, its flagship student ambassador program for bold, driven college students…

blocks.text: The search is on for the new batch of Galaxy trailblazers as Samsung opens the applications for the Galaxy Campus Batch 4, its flagship student ambassador program for bold, driven college students ready to develop their voice, strengthen their influence, and discover what they can achieve beyond the feed.

Extended until October 4, 2026, current college students from any Philippine college or university can submit their applications for a chance to be part of the 50 new Galaxy Campus student ambassadors.
What’s in it for the Batch 4 of Galaxy Campus?

More than just a student program, the Galaxy Campus Batch 4 serves as the launchpad for the next generation of tech-driven leaders, storytellers, and changemakers. This program offers relevant skill-building activities and exclusive access to Samsung events and early hands-on experiences with the latest Galaxy devices.

Designed to bridge student creativity with industry excellence, Galaxy Campus offers comprehensive training in content creation, digital marketing, and strategic leadership. Student ambassadors gain hands-on experience through exclusive workshops, innovative brand challenges, and direct mentorship from top tech and creative professionals.

Some of the exciting things that the Galaxy Campus Batch 3 student ambassadors did were going through different universities with the Galaxy Campus Club to showcase Galaxy devices and introduce the Samsung Education Store among their peers. They also participated in meaningful activities like A Galaxy of Giving where they collaborated with the students of Philippine School for the Deaf to design tables and chairs for the school.

If you are a college student in the Philippines with at least one academic year left, demonstrate leadership, are willing to create content and join affiliate marketing, and maintain good academic and disciplinary standing, then you might be one of the next Galaxy Campus Student Ambassadors!
You can join by following the mechanics below:

items: Prepare: Gather your requirements and get ready to stand out.

Post: Create and post a 90-second video on TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram and use #GalaxyCampusPH. Introduce yourself, share your leadership story, and tell us why you are the perfect fit to become a Galaxy Campus Ambassador. Do not forget to set your video to public so we can see your submission!
Submit: Complete the application by submitting the requirements at the Galaxy Campus portal in this link: http://spr.ly/GalaxyCampusBatch4Recruitment

blocks.text: You still have time to submit your application until October 4, 2026, so go ahead and show us that you are the next trailblazer we are looking for!
This article is brought to you by Samsung.
